lines.zh: 我走得很稳，海水从衣角滴下。
lines.en: I walk steadily, seawater dripping from my hem.

lines.zh: 长靴踩过湿地，没有声音。
lines.en: My tall boots cross wet ground without a sound.

lines.zh: 这具身体比人高一点，肩很宽。
lines.en: This body stands a little taller than a man, shoulders broad.

lines.zh: 我沿着海岸走，一步一步。
lines.en: I walk the shoreline, step by step.
The sea taught me not to hurry.

lines.zh: 我每走一步都听一遍四周。
lines.en: Each step, I listen to the whole shore.

lines.zh: 我的大剑拖在地上，划出一道痕。
lines.en: My greatsword drags, cutting a line.

lines.zh: 手臂上的鳞在光下发暗。
lines.en: The scales on my arm darken in the light.
I walk toward wherever the monsters are.
The water parts beneath my feet.
My shadow drags across the wet sand.

lines.zh: 我走了很久，衣服还是湿的。
lines.en: I have walked far; my clothes are still wet.

lines.zh: 我从木门边走过，门在抖。
lines.en: I pass a wooden door, and it trembles.
I follow the smell of blood; it does not lie.
My steps pack the sand down.

lines.zh: 我一整天都在走，不觉得累。
lines.en: I walk all day and do not tire.

lines.zh: 我站着，水顺着下颌落下。
lines.en: I stand, water running off my jaw.

lines.zh: 我按着剑柄，没有拔出来。
lines.en: I rest a hand on the hilt, not drawing.

lines.zh: 这身甲胄，是从海里捞的。
lines.en: This armor was pulled from the sea.

lines.zh: 我听见很远的怪物在叫。
lines.en: I hear monsters calling far away.
My breathing is slow, one long breath.
Sea wind pushes the clouds close.
I stand and wait for an enemy.

lines.zh: 我的护甲上有一道旧裂口。
lines.en: There is an old split in my armor.

lines.zh: 我转了转手腕，骨节在响。
lines.en: I roll my wrist and the joints crack.
The air on land is too dry.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，怪物就不敢过来。
lines.en: I stand here, and monsters keep away.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己的手，还像人。
lines.en: I look at my hand. Still human-shaped.
I do not enter the village over there.
I keep waiting for a direction.

lines.zh: 你身上没有海嗣的味道。
lines.en: You do not carry the smell of seaborn.

lines.zh: 我不主动杀人，但我也不护送人。
lines.en: I do not kill unprovoked, nor do I escort.

lines.zh: 你看见我的剑了，它比你还高。
lines.en: You have seen my sword; it is taller than you.
Your hand is moving toward a weapon.

lines.zh: 我不是怪物，可我也不是人了。
lines.en: I am not a monster, but no longer human either.
Step back and I will not move.
The sea calls me back. I have not gone.
If you want a fight, draw first.
Go; this place is not safe.
You speak; I may not answer.
Another gash in the armor.
A plate rings; I stay upright.

lines.zh: 两百一十八点，够撑很久。
lines.en: Two hundred and eighteen — it will last.
I have been through this pain before.
I wipe the blood away.
I grip the blade tighter.
This wound landed on an old scar.
My breathing deepens once.
Pain will not make me retreat.
You struck well.
I stopped living by my mouth long ago.

lines.zh: 你需要靠食物活着，我不需要。
lines.en: You need food to live. I do not.
Put your hand back.

lines.zh: 我闻到的不是食物，是海。
lines.en: What I smell is not food. It is the sea.
Keep that for yourself.
I do not feel hunger.
Your hand reaches too far.
Keep it for someone still hungry.

lines.zh: 走开，别站在我剑的前面。
lines.en: Move; do not stand at the point of my sword.
Holding it up like that is dangerous.

lines.zh: 你撞在我甲上，声音很沉。
lines.en: You struck my armor; the sound was deep.
Your shoulder strikes me and goes no further.
Back off, or my blade will find you.
The shove moved me one step sideways.
We need not be this close.
That barely moved me.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞上了我的护肩。
lines.en: Your shoulder met my pauldron.
My pauldron took the force for you.
The water on the ground scatters.
Again, and I will take it as hostility.
This bloodline needs no continuance.
I am a hunter, not a mate.
Seaborn have no such thing.

lines.zh: 我连自己的心跳都觉得陌生。
lines.en: Even my own heartbeat feels unfamiliar.
That is a poor question to ask.
My companions are all in the sea.

lines.zh: 这具身体已经不属于我了。
lines.en: This body no longer belongs to me.
Such talk is a luxury for hunters.
I have no room for that.
Leave; I have a shore to patrol.

lines.zh: 我捡起一枚湿透的护符。
lines.en: I pick up a soaked charm.
The seawater has rotted it.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进腰后的暗袋。
lines.en: I tuck it into the pouch behind my belt.
Too heavy; one hand cannot hold it.
I know this pattern.

lines.zh: 我拿起来看了看，又放下。
lines.en: I lift it, look, and set it down.
This belonged to the dead.
This is not mine to carry off.
The smell of blood, and old.

lines.zh: 我握了一下，手甲硌得响。
lines.en: I close my grip; the gauntlet grinds.

lines.zh: 有怪物在附近，我闻到了。
lines.en: A monster is near. I smell it.
Smaller than me, but not few.
I do not draw quickly.
One cut will do.
It has noticed me.
I step forward; it steps back.

lines.zh: 这具身体就是为这个造的。
lines.en: This body was made for this.
I hold my breath and close in.
It moved. Then we begin.

lines.zh: 盯上的东西，不换第二个。
lines.en: What I fix on, I do not trade for another.

lines.zh: 我一步步压过去，不等它进剑。
lines.en: I press in step by step, not waiting for it.
It circles; I do not chase.
My armor makes it hesitate.
It backs to a wall. Good.
I block its only way out.
This thing does not tire. I do.
But I have died once already.
It lunges; I turn aside.
It pushed through the door; I follow.
It is starting to fear. Three steps left.
One cut, clean.
The blade opens its shell.
Thirty-four damage is enough.
I turn and cut upward.

lines.zh: 它撞在我甲上，我退了半步。
lines.en: It slams my armor and I give half a step.

lines.zh: 这剑很重，落下就收不住。
lines.en: The blade is heavy; once it falls, it will not stop.
It is not dead; I add a cut.
I do not watch it fall.

lines.zh: 这一击，是为了岸上的人。
lines.en: This blow is for the people on shore.
One more and it ends.

lines.zh: 我从浪里走上岸，甲胄上全是水。
lines.en: I walk up out of the surf, armor soaked.
My first step lands on wet sand.
I grip the sword in my hand.

lines.zh: 这具身体比我原来的高。
lines.en: This body is taller than my old one.
The sea is behind me; I do not look back.

lines.zh: 空气太干，吸进去有点刺。
lines.en: The air is too dry; it stings.

lines.zh: 我记得自己是猎人，别的记不清。
lines.en: I remember being a hunter. The rest is unclear.
I head toward where the monsters are.
I will hold this shoreline.
Tonight will not be quiet.

lines.zh: 火燎过甲缝，皮在下面烧。
lines.en: Fire licks the armor seams; skin burns beneath.

lines.zh: 我落地时砸出坑，甲也凹了。
lines.en: I land in a crater, armor dented.

lines.zh: 海水灌进肺里，可我已经不需要它。
lines.en: Seawater fills my lungs; I no longer need them.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推倒，我撑剑起身。
lines.en: The blast knocks me down; I rise on my blade.
An arrow sticks in my pauldron.
A curse slips into my seams, cold.
I am not hungry, yet the body weakens.
Lightning runs down the blade into me.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我落进黑里。
lines.en: No ground below; I fall into the dark.
